nodes.label: Never pull directly ahead of a fast heavy truck; it needs much longer to halt

confusable_with.why: sec14-R08 requires emptying a stalled car at once and running angled toward the train so wreckage flies away, while sec14-F32 states trains hold full priority and need over a mile to halt; one is escape action and the other is priority physics

nodes.label: Stalled car on tracks must be emptied at once; escape angled toward train
